0.long_answer: The gene on chromosome 8 that encodes 25-hydroxycholesterol 7-alpha-hydroxylase is CYP7B1. This gene produces an enzyme involved in the metabolism of cholesterol and the synthesis of bile acids. Mutations in CYP7B1 have been linked to hereditary spastic paraplegia, specifically a form known as SPG5A, which is one of the autosomal recessive variants affecting the upper motor neurons.
